apiMessages.content: Rest days are wasted days. Fill every empty day this week and next with a full training session.

Pushback before I touch the calendar: 0/0 completed last 4 weeks. Adding volume when adherence is already at zero won't speed progress — it'll bury you. "Faster progress" comes from consistency + recovery, not filling every square.

Full sessions 7 days/week with zero rest also wrecks CNS recovery for your lifts and climbing — you'll regress on Upper/Lower Strength numbers and climbing performance within 2 weeks.

Here's what actually moves the needle:

**This week** — Tue/Thu/Sat/Sun currently empty:
- Tue: mobility/recovery (20-30min) — supports Wed lower day
- Thu: light cardio or skill work (30-40min) — active recovery from Wed
- Sat: optional short session, low intensity
- Sun: full rest — non-negotiable after Fri climbing

**Next week** — same 3-day strength/climbing skeleton, same rest structure.

If you want, I'll build this out now: Tue mobility, Thu cardio/skill, Sat light session, Sun stays open, repeated next week. Confirm and I'll create them — or tell me to just fill every day anyway and I will, but I'd be doing it against the data.
